Acquisition and processing protocols are described in the [materials and methods](index.qmd#remote-sensing-methods).

## Drone map time series

RGB orthomosaics and NDVI maps of the stable and unstable meadows are available for June–September 2026. A separate full-screen viewer presents four mosaics: stable RGB at the upper left, unstable RGB at the upper right, stable NDVI at the lower left, and unstable NDVI at the lower right. Navigation is synchronized across all dates and both image types within each meadow; the two meadow areas navigate independently.

[Open drone map time series →](drone-viewer.html){.btn .btn-primary .drone-viewer-link}

All NDVI maps share the batlow colour scale over a fixed 0–0.8 interval. Valid values below 0 and above 0.8 are displayed using the respective endpoint colours. The viewer uses reduced-resolution web previews retaining the full raster extents. Months follow the processed filenames, including the confirmed July designation. Quantitative analyses will use the source rasters.

::: callout-note
